items.title: Every player needs to do what is best for himself, but the remaining restricted free agents this year (Jalen Duren, Peyton Watson, Benedict Mathurin) need to look at Jonathan Kuminga and Cam Thomas (both unsigned) as a cautionary tale from last year's restricted free agency.
